arcs.title: Flashpoint
arcs.description: Barry Allen goes back in time to prevent his mother’s murder, but the change creates a world at war between the Amazons and Atlantis. Hal Jordan never becomes Green Lantern in this timeline, while Abin Sur remains active on Earth and becomes involved in the conflict. The Green Lantern tie-ins show how the altered history changes the lives and roles of both Hal and Abin Sur.

series.title: Flashpoint: Abin Sur – The Green Lantern

arcs.title: Twilight of the Guardians
arcs.description: The Controllers kidnap Ganthet and the other remaining Guardians, intending to eliminate them and take control of the universe. Hal Jordan assembles John Stewart, Guy Gardner and Kyle Rayner to rescue them. The team discovers that the Controllers’ plan is far more than a simple hostage-taking, and the four Lanterns must stop their oldest enemies before the Guardians are killed.

series.title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps

arcs.title: Last Charge
arcs.description: Tomar-Tu kills the criminal Romat-Ru instead of bringing him to justice, and the Corps strips him of his ring. Convinced that the Lanterns’ ban on killing lets dangerous criminals escape real punishment, Tomar-Tu joins the Darkstars, whose armor gives them the power to impose lethal justice. The Darkstars attack Mogo, forcing John Stewart to lead the Corps in defending its home and proving that justice does not require executions; Hal confronts Tomar-Tu in the final battle.

series.title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps

arcs.title: Sinestro
arcs.description: The Guardians give Sinestro a Green Lantern ring again, while Hal Jordan has been stripped of his own ring and is struggling on Earth. Sinestro recruits Hal by restoring his ring, but keeps control over it and can shut it off whenever he wants. Together they travel to Korugar to overthrow the Sinestro Corps, which has enslaved the planet Sinestro once ruled. They free Korugar, but the Guardians’ decision to remove Ganthet’s emotions and create a replacement army sets up a much larger threat.

arcs.title: The Secret of the Indigo Tribe
arcs.description: Indigo-1 and her Indigo Lanterns abduct Sinestro because the Guardians have allowed him to become a Green Lantern again; Hal follows him to the Indigo homeworld. There, Hal and Sinestro are stripped of their usual powers and learn that the Tribe’s members were violent criminals transformed by Abin Sur and Natromo into beings who feel compassion. Indigo-1 was once Iroque, a murderer, and the indigo light forces her and the others to experience empathy. The story also advances the Guardians’ plan to replace the Green Lantern Corps.

arcs.title: The Revenge of Black Hand
arcs.description: The Indigo Tribe releases Sinestro from its control and places him under Hal Jordan’s custody, with the two rings’ control reversed so Hal can shut off Sinestro’s power. Meanwhile, Black Hand escapes the Tribe by killing himself and returning from the dead; he resurrects his family and plans to turn the living into the undead so he will no longer be alone. Hal and Sinestro track the growing threat, while the Guardians move against Sinestro and the Indigo Tribe prepares to challenge them.
